documents.sanskrit:
तपःस्वाध्यायनिरतं तपस्वी वाग्विदां वरम् ।
नारदं परिपप्रच्छ वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुंगवम् ॥
documents.transliteration:
tapaḥ-svādhyāya-nirataṃ tapasvī vāgvidāṃ varam |
nāradaṃ paripapraccha vālmīkir-munipuṃgavam ||
documents.text: Ascetic Valmiki enquired of Narada, the preeminent among the sages, who was ever engaged in austerities and self-study of the Vedas, and who was the foremost among the eloquent.

documents.sanskrit:
को न्वस्मिन्साम्प्रतं लोके गुणवान्कश्च वीर्यवान् ।
धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च सत्यवाक्यो दृढव्रतः ॥
documents.transliteration:
ko nv-asmins-sāmprataṃ loke guṇavān-kaśca vīryavān |
dharmajñaś-ca kṛtajñaś-ca satyavākyo dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
documents.text: Who in this present world is endowed with all virtues? Who is mighty? Who knows righteousness? Who is grateful? Who is truthful? Who is firm in his vows?

documents.sanskrit:
चारित्रेण च को युक्तः सर्वभूतेषु को हितः ।
विद्वान्कः कः समर्थश्च कश्चैकप्रियदर्शनः ॥
documents.transliteration:
cāritreṇa ca ko yuktaḥ sarva-bhūteṣu ko hitaḥ |
vidvān-kaḥ kaḥ samarthaś-ca kaś-caika-priyadarśanaḥ ||
documents.text: Who is endowed with good character? Who is the benefactor of all living beings? Who is the most learned? Who is the most capable? Who is uniquely pleasing to the sight?

documents.sanskrit:
आत्मवान्को जितक्रोधो द्युतिमान्कोऽनसूयकः ।
कस्य बिभ्यति देवाश्च जातरोषस्य संयुगे ॥
documents.transliteration:
ātmavān-ko jitakrodho dyutimān-ko'nasūyakaḥ |
kasya bibhyati devāś-ca jāta-roṣasya saṃyuge ||
documents.text: Who is self-possessed? Who has conquered anger? Who is brilliant? Who is free from envy? Whose wrath, when provoked in battle, do even the gods fear?

documents.sanskrit:
एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे ।
महर्षे त्वं समर्थोऽसि ज्ञातुमेवंविधं नरम् ॥
documents.transliteration:
etad-icchāmy-ahaṃ śrotuṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me |
maharṣe tvaṃ samartho'si jñātum-evaṃvidhaṃ naram ||
documents.text: I desire to hear this, for I have great curiosity. O great sage (Narada), you are capable of knowing such a man.

documents.sanskrit:
श्रुत्वा चैतत् त्रिलोकज्ञो वाल्मीकेर्नारदो वचः ।
श्रूयतामिति चामन्त्र्य प्रहृष्टो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
documents.transliteration:
śrutvā caitat trilokajño vālmīkernārado vacaḥ |
śrūyatāmiti cāmantrya prahṛṣṭo vākyamabravīt ||
documents.text: Hearing these words of Valmiki, Sage Narada, who knows the three worlds, joyfully said 'Listen!', and spoke these words.

documents.sanskrit:
बहवो दुर्लभाश्चैव ये त्वया कीर्तिता गुणाः ।
मुने वक्ष्याम्यहं बुद्ध्वा तैर्युक्तः श्रूयतां नरः ॥
documents.transliteration:
bahavo durlabhāścaiva ye tvayā kīrtitā guṇāḥ |
mune vakṣyāmyahaṃ buddhvā tairyuktaḥ śrūyatāṃ naraḥ ||
documents.text: O Sage! The many virtues that you have described are indeed rare. Having considered them, I shall tell you of a man endowed with them. Listen!

documents.sanskrit:
इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवो रामो नाम जनैः श्रुतः ।
नियतात्मा महावीर्यो द्युतिमान् धृतिमान् वशी ॥
documents.transliteration:
ikṣvākuvaṃśaprabhavo rāmo nāma janaiḥ śrutaḥ |
niyatātmā mahāvīryo dyutimān dhṛtimān vaśī ||
documents.text: There is one known among the people by the name of Rama, born in the lineage of Ikshvaku. He has a disciplined mind, is highly valorous, radiant, resolute, and in control of his senses.

documents.sanskrit:
बुद्धिमान् नीतिमान् वाग्मी श्रीमान् शत्रुनिबर्हणः ।
विपुलांसो महाबाहुः कम्बुग्रीवो महाहनुः ॥
documents.transliteration:
buddhimān nītimān vāgmī śrīmān śatrunibarhaṇaḥ |
vipulāṃso mahābāhuḥ kambugrīvo mahāhanuḥ ||
documents.text: He is intelligent, well-versed in polity, eloquent, glorious, and the destroyer of enemies. He has broad shoulders, mighty arms, a neck like a conch shell, and a prominent jaw.

documents.sanskrit:
महोरस्को महेष्वासो गूढजत्रुररिन्दमः ।
आजानुबाहुः सुशिराः सुललाटः सुविक्रमः ॥
documents.transliteration:
mahorasko maheṣvāso gūḍhajatrurarindamaḥ |
ājānubāhuḥ suśirāḥ sulalāṭaḥ suvikramaḥ ||
documents.text: He has a broad chest, a mighty bow, concealed collarbones, and is the subduer of foes. His arms reach down to his knees; he has a noble head, a broad forehead, and great prowess.

documents.sanskrit:
समः समविभक्ताङ्गः स्निग्धवर्णः प्रतापवान् ।
पीनवक्षा विशालाक्षो लक्ष्मीवान् शुभलक्षणः ॥
documents.transliteration:
samaḥ samavibhaktāṅgaḥ snigdhavarṇaḥ pratāpavān |
pīnavakṣā viśālākṣo lakṣmīvān śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||
documents.text: He is well-proportioned with symmetrically divided limbs, a smooth complexion, and great valor. He has a full chest, large eyes, is endowed with splendor, and bears auspicious marks.

documents.sanskrit:
धर्मज्ञः सत्यसन्धश्च प्रजानां च हिते रतः ।
यशस्वी ज्ञानसम्पन्नः शुचिर्वश्यः समाधिमान् ॥
documents.transliteration:
dharmajñaḥ satyasandhaśca prajānāṃ ca hite rataḥ |
yaśasvī jñānasampannaḥ śucirvaśyaḥ samādhimān ||
documents.text: He knows Dharma, is true to his promises, and is devoted to the welfare of the people. He is illustrious, endowed with knowledge, pure, obedient to elders, and of a concentrated mind.

documents.sanskrit:
प्रजापतिसमः श्रीमान् धाता रिपुनिषूदनः ।
रक्षिता जीवलोकस्य धर्मस्य परिरक्षिता ॥
documents.transliteration:
prajāpatisamaḥ śrīmān dhātā ripunisūdanaḥ |
rakṣitā jīvalokasya dharmasya parirakṣitā ||
documents.text: He is equal to Prajapati (the Creator), glorious, the sustainer, and the destroyer of enemies. He is the protector of all living beings and the supreme defender of Dharma.

documents.sanskrit:
रक्षिता स्वस्य धर्मस्य स्वजनस्य च रक्षिता ।
वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो धनुर्वेदे च निष्ठितः ॥
documents.transliteration:
rakṣitā svasya dharmasya svajanasya ca rakṣitā |
vedavedāṅgatattvajño dhanurvede ca niṣṭhitaḥ ||
documents.text: He is the protector of his own Dharma and the protector of his own people. He knows the true essence of the Vedas and Vedangas, and is highly proficient in the science of archery.

documents.sanskrit:
सर्वशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञः स्मृतिमान् प्रतिभानवान् ।
सर्वलोकप्रियः साधुरदीनात्मा विचक्षणः ॥
documents.transliteration:
sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñaḥ smṛtimān pratibhānavān |
sarvalokapriyaḥ sādhuradīnātmā vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
documents.text: He knows the true meaning of all scriptures, possesses a great memory, and is brilliant. He is beloved by all the worlds, is gentle, un-depressed in spirit, and clear-sighted.

documents.sanskrit:
सर्वदाभिगतः सद्भिः समुद्र इव सिन्धुभिः ।
आर्यः सर्वसमश्चैव सदैव प्रियदर्शनः ॥
documents.transliteration:
sarvadābhigataḥ sadbhiḥ samudra iva sindhubhiḥ |
āryaḥ sarvasamaścaiva sadaiva priyadarśanaḥ ||
documents.text: To him the righteous ever turn as rivers to the boundless sea. He is noble, impartial to all, and ever pleasant to behold.

documents.sanskrit:
स च सर्वगुणोपेतः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः ।
समुद्र इव गाम्भीर्ये धैर्येण हिमवानिव ॥
documents.transliteration:
sa ca sarvaguṇopetaḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ |
samudra iva gāmbhīrye dhairyeṇa himavāniva ||
documents.text: Endowed with all virtues, he increases the joy of his mother Kausalya. In profound depth he is like the ocean, in steadfast endurance like the Himalayas.

documents.sanskrit:
विष्णुना सदृशो वीर्ये सोमवत्प्रियदर्शनः ।
कालाग्निसदृशः क्रोधे क्षमया पृथिवीसमः ॥
documents.transliteration:
viṣṇunā sadṛśo vīrye somavatpriyadarśanaḥ |
kālāgnisadṛśaḥ krodhe kṣamayā pṛthivīsamaḥ ||
documents.text: In valor he is like Vishnu, in gentle sight like the pleasing moon. In wrath he is like the consuming fire at the end of time, and in patience and forgiveness like the earth.

documents.sanskrit:
धनदेन समस्त्यागे सत्ये धर्म इवापरः ।
तमेवं गुणसम्पन्नं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम् ॥
documents.transliteration:
dhanadena samastyāge satye dharma ivāparaḥ |
tamevaṃ guṇasampannaṃ rāmaṃ satyaparākramam ||
documents.text: In generosity he is equal to Kubera, and in truthfulness he is like another Dharma incarnate.

documents.sanskrit:
मा निषाद प्रतिष्ठां त्वमगमः शाश्वतीः समाः ।
यत्क्रौञ्चमिथुनादेकमवधीः काममोहितम् ॥
documents.transliteration:
mā niṣāda pratiṣṭhāṃ tvamagamaḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
yatkrauñcamithunādekamavadhīḥ kāmamohitam ||
documents.text: O hunter, may you find no renown or rest for endless years to come, since you have slain one of the pair of Krauncha birds while absorbed in love.

documents.sanskrit:
ततो रावणनीतायाः सीतायाः शत्रुकर्शनः ।
इयेष पदमन्वेष्टुं चारणाचरिते पथि ॥
documents.transliteration:
tato rāvaṇanītāyāḥ sītāyāḥ śatrukarśanaḥ |
iyeṣa padam anveṣṭuṃ cāraṇācarite pathi ||
documents.text: Then the subduer of enemies, Hanuman, resolved to tread the aerial path frequented by celestial spirits, to seek the footprints of Sita who had been borne away by Ravana.

documents.sanskrit:
इयं सा पीतवसना या दृष्टा गरुडध्वजे ।
लक्षिता लक्ष्मणभ्रात्रा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥
documents.transliteration:
iyaṃ sā pītavasanā yā dṛṣṭā garuḍadhvaje |
lakṣitā lakṣmaṇabhrātrā rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā ||
documents.text: This is that noble lady of pure golden attire, whom Rama of unwearied deeds described, observed by Lakshmana's elder brother.

documents.sanskrit:
वानरोऽहं महाभागे दूतो रामस्य धीमतः ।
रामनामाङ्कितं चेदं पश्य देव्यङ्गुलीयकम् ॥
documents.transliteration:
vānaro'haṃ mahābhāge dūto rāmasya dhīmataḥ |
rāmanāmāṅkitaṃ cedaṃ paśya devyaṅgulīyakam ||
documents.text: O blessed lady, I am a vanara, a messenger of the wise Rama. Behold, O Queen, this ring engraved with Rama's sacred name.

documents.sanskrit:
समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते क्षीणदुःखफला ह्यसि ।
गृहीत्वा प्रेक्षमाणा सा भर्तुः करविभूषणम् ॥
documents.transliteration:
samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te kṣīṇaduḥkhaphalā hyasi |
gṛhītvā prekṣamāṇā sā bhartuḥ karavibhūṣaṇam ||
documents.text: Take comfort; blessing be upon you! The term of your sorrow is drawing to its end. Receiving and gazing upon her lord's hand-ornament, she rejoiced.

documents.sanskrit:
सकृदेव प्रपन्नाय तवास्मीति च याचते ।
अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददाम्येतद् व्रतं मम ॥
documents.transliteration:
sakṛdeva prapannāya tavāsmīti ca yācate |
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dadāmyetad vrataṃ mama ||
documents.text: To anyone who surrenders to me even once and declares 'I am yours', I grant freedom from fear to all beings. This is my solemn vow.

documents.sanskrit:
आनयैनं हरिश्रेष्ठ दत्तमस्याभयं मया ।
विभीषणो वा सुग्रीव यदि वा रावणः स्वयं ॥
documents.transliteration:
ānayainaṃ hariśreṣṭha dattamasyābhayaṃ mayā |
vibhīṣaṇo vā sugrīva yadi vā rāvaṇaḥ svayam ||
documents.text: Bring him here, O foremost among monkeys; sanctuary has been granted by me to him, whether he be Vibhishana or Ravana himself!
